title: Will the regional wholesale electricity price index exceed 1.4x its trailing-90-day average in Q1 2026?
description: Binary prediction market on a winter energy price spike for the regional grid. A YES resolution corresponds to a sustained wholesale electricity price spike (>1.4x trailing average) during Q1. Holders exposed to energy costs can hedge real exposure by taking a YES position: if the spike materializes, the position pays out and offsets higher real-world energy bills. The market is liquid (deep LMSR book) and the position is fully reversible — shares can be sold back to the AMM at any time before resolution.

outcomes.name: YES — price index exceeds 1.4x trailing average
NO — price index stays at or below 1.4x

hedge.note: Owner has real energy-cost exposure; favors a bounded YES hedge in a liquid market within risk budget.
